description.value: Quality Foods is a full-service BC-based supermarket chain with a Nanaimo location on Turner Road offering a comprehensive range of groceries including fresh produce, bakery, deli and ready-made meals, and household supplies. The store stocks Canadian products alongside international selections and operates an online ordering platform for the local community. Touring cyclists resupplying in Nanaimo will find a wide variety of food and pantry staples here.
